intro: Browsers report here each time a page of this realm broke its Content Security Policy: the policy stopped a script, a frame, a style or another resource from loading or running. A report says what a browser claims, and anybody can send one, so read these as signals: a run of reports for one directive after a change is a page the change broke, and a blocked origin nobody here uses can be an injection a browser stopped.
since: Counted by this node's front process since {since}; the counts are not kept across a restart.
none: No browser has reported a violation since then.
limits: Pages report to {path}. It reads a body of at most {bytes} bytes and {perMinute} reports a minute from one address, records the directive, the page's path without its query and the blocked origin, and writes each report to the service log.
forwardOn: Each accepted report is also forwarded to the collector set below.
forwardOff: Reports are not forwarded. Set the collector below to forward them.
notForwarded: {count} reports were not forwarded because too many forwards were outstanding.
